sloka: तथा ब्रुवति रामे तु जामदग्न्ये प्रतापवान् ।रामो दाशरथिः श्रीमान् चिक्षेप शरम् उत्तमम् ॥१-७६-२१॥
transliteration: tathā bruvati rāme tu jāmadagnye pratāpavān ।rāmo dāśarathiḥ śrīmān cikṣepa śaram uttamam ॥1-76-21॥

translations.english: Thus spoke Parasurama, son of Jamadagni to Rama, the valiant son of Dasaratha who (then) discharged the principal arrow.
